title: DIANES: A DEI Audit Toolkit for News Sources
reasoning: The paper describes a technical toolkit for auditing demographic representation (specifically gender and race) in news sourcing to support Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) goals. While it is motivated by ethical concerns in journalism and developed in collaboration with an ethics center, the work focuses on the automated extraction and classification of source demographics rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, moral philosophies, or ethical frameworks themselves.
